ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and median notch boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary contiguous black mass forms the lobe surfaces. Distinct, high-contrast white geometric blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips (distal points) of both lobes. Smaller, fragmented white clusters are positioned along the rim of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a clearly defined vertex; depth is approximately 1/6th of the vertical height of the visible fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary showing high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel peaks (serrations) along the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregularity at the lateral tips where white clusters are present.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a strong convex curvature sweeping upwards and outwards from the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters at the furthest lateral points of both lobes, containing circular sub-features.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, thin, white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the inner-to-mid section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white high-contrast clusters/scarring on both lobe tips; multiple parallel linear abrasions on the surface of the right lobe.
